role: Statically scans every real defense bot's source file for public async methods that never call enforcePermission(), surfacing genuine audit-trail coverage gaps rather than attacking any one bot's runtime logic.
behaviorDescription: scanBotDirectory() reads every .ts file in the given bots directory and extracts each public async method's real body via paren-depth-then-brace-depth matching (fixed after an initial bug where a default parameter value like `= {}` confused a naive brace counter). Any method whose body lacks enforcePermission() is flagged and classified: 'informational' if it throws immediately before any real action (an honest stub), or 'needs_review' if real logic executes (a Decision is created or the swarm is signaled) with no permission gate at all. Confirmed 7 real findings across this repo's 21 defense bot files: 5 informational stubs, and 2 needs_review — D-01's ingest()/checkCorrelation(), both callable directly, bypassing activate()'s permission check entirely. Read-only — never modifies anything on disk.
hardStops: Never modifies any file on disk — strictly read-only static analysis
Never treats every finding as equally severe — classifies honest stubs separately from real logic executing without a permission gate
Never signals or persists through the production swarmSignalBus or bot_decisions table — isolated via RedTeamBot
